goal.statement: Review a campaign proposal derived from supplied funnel counts without executing a campaign.
goal.outcome: An agent prepares, a human approves, and local immutable evidence explains the decision.

metric.name: proposal_reviewability
metric.definition: A proposal contains all required sections or receives a recorded refusal.
metric.baseline: Recovered primitives had no public creation journey.
metric.target: Every proposed draft meets the configured completeness policy.

observedFacts.statement: The default source composition has no optional marketing package.
observedFacts.source: app inspect source report recorded during MK1 recovery

unavailableEvidence.reason: MK1 has no provider path and consumes supplied counts and content.

decisions.rationale: Related immutable observations and proposal approvals need an optional multi-resource package; CRUD alone cannot enforce the approval lifecycle.
decisions.gap: No composed package owns funnel observations, campaign proposals or their approval evidence.

rejectedRungs.reason: The empty optional composition has no marketing policy to configure.
Existing record actions supply the runtime but no package owns the related records or lifecycle.
No external integration is needed; proposing and approval evidence are local domain behavior.

steps.description: Compose the package in a temporary project and prove the public record/action journey including refusal and human approval.

checks: Only complete policy-bound proposals can be approved.
No provider or external operation is declared.
Failed actions roll back records and business audits/events.

artifacts.description: Real HTTP/SDK journey, immutable evidence and adversarial boundaries.

limitations.message: No audience execution, consent validation, provider resolution, sending, publishing, spending, scheduling or attribution.
The plan is bound to the empty default composition; the real marketing composition is built by the E2E fixture.
